articles.title: Major study challenges long-held fears about acetaminophen and ibuprofen use in babies
articles.summary: A landmark study of nearly 4,000 babies found that acetaminophen and ibuprofen were equally safe during infancy. Researchers will continue following the children through age six to study possible long-term effects.
